cards.title: What a shard looks like
cards.text: You marked the gold crystal a problem. Tick the looks you like for the module pickup.
cards.why: It sits in dead ends and rooms and has to read as 'a spell part' from across the screen.
cards.details: The colour idea works with any of them: the pickup shows the rarity of what's inside.

items.label: Crystal, rarity colour
items.text: Same crystal, coloured by what it holds: white, green, blue, purple, gold.

items.label: Rune circle
items.text: A glowing ring drawn on the floor. Walk onto it.

items.label: Orb on a stand
items.text: A gold ball resting on a small dark stand.

items.label: Spell book
items.text: A closed book with a sigil. Each one is a page of spell.

items.label: Floating cube
items.text: A small cube hovering and turning slowly.

items.label: Obelisk
items.text: A tall thin stone with a glowing band. Touch it.

items.label: Glyph plate
items.text: A raised square plate in the floor with a glyph.

items.label: Spinning star
items.text: A four-point star turning in the air.

cards.title: The after images
cards.text: You said the enemy pictures had after images. Was that the films (trails behind moving things)?
cards.why: If it's in the game itself I'll fix it there; if only the films, I'll film differently.
cards.pick: I think it was the films: they're made from 30 snapshots a second, which smears fast darts.
